description: Provenance for every dataset slice shipped with Unmapped Kairos. Each entry cites the original source, the year of the underlying data, and notes any curation that was applied. ETL scripts in scripts/etl/ document how to refresh.

frey-osborne.title: Frey & Osborne automation probabilities by occupation
frey-osborne.citation: Frey, C. B., & Osborne, M. A. (2017). The future of employment: How susceptible are jobs to computerisation? Technological Forecasting and Social Change, 114, 254-280.
frey-osborne.license: Academic publication; values cited under fair use
frey-osborne.scope: Curated subset of ~50 occupations spanning the full risk distribution; original paper has 702 SOC occupations.
frey-osborne.calibration_note: Frey-Osborne assumes US task composition. Unmapped Kairos applies LMIC recalibration (alpha, beta) per CountryContext.

isco-08.title: International Standard Classification of Occupations 2008
isco-08.citation: International Labour Organization (2012). ISCO-08 Volume I: Structure, group definitions and correspondence tables.
isco-08.scope: Top-level 10 major groups, plus selected sub-major groups and unit groups relevant to demo personas.

esco.title: European Skills, Competences and Occupations classification (subset)
esco.scope: Curated subset of ~80 skills + ~25 occupations; multilingual labels (en, es, pt). Bangla and Twi labels filled by translation, not ESCO source.

ilostat-wages.title: Mean nominal monthly earnings of employees by economic activity (ILOSTAT)
ilostat-wages.scope: Median monthly earnings by ISIC sector for the 4 demo countries. Some sectors imputed from neighboring sectors where ILOSTAT had gaps; imputation flagged in records.

wdi.title: World Development Indicators (selected)
indicators: SL.UEM.NEET.ZS — Share of youth not in education, employment or training
SL.EMP.WORK.ZS — Wage and salaried workers (% of employment)

data360-informality.title: Informal employment (% of total non-agricultural employment)

wittgenstein.title: Wittgenstein Centre Human Capital Data Explorer (subset)
wittgenstein.citation: Wittgenstein Centre for Demography and Global Human Capital, Human Capital Data Explorer Version 2.0 (2024).
wittgenstein.scope: Population by education attainment, projected 2025-2035, age 20-29 (youth proxy), both sexes, SSP2 scenario.

ilo-future-of-work.title: ILO Future of Work task content indices (subset)
ilo-future-of-work.citation: ILO (2023). Routine vs. non-routine task share by country and sector.
ilo-future-of-work.scope: Per-sector routine task share for the 4 demo countries; values calibrated from comparable LMIC studies where direct figures were missing.

honest_limits: Snapshots are versioned and dated; they do not auto-refresh. ETL scripts in scripts/etl/ document refresh procedures.
Some sectoral wage figures are imputed from neighboring sectors where source data has gaps; imputed records carry an `imputed: true` flag.
Frey-Osborne probabilities are US-derived. The CountryContext.automation.calibration formula recalibrates them for LMIC contexts; the formula is exposed to the user, not buried.
ESCO multilingual labels for Bangla and Twi were translated from English (ESCO does not natively support these languages). Verifications recommended for production use.
